products.name: Udio
products.note: AI music generation; copyright risk; likeness in vocals; RIAA litigation context

profile_text.body:
Udio is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company operates an AI music generation platform at udio.com, which it describes as a tool to discover, create, and share music using the latest technology to produce AI-generated music in seconds.

The company's core product, also called Udio, falls within the voice and audio category and carries noted concerns around copyright risk and likeness in vocals. Udio is a defendant in UMG Recordings v. Uncharted Labs, Inc. (Udio), filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, a case arising in the context of RIAA litigation over AI music generation.
